claims: Chuck Norris was formerly a Democrat.
Chuck Norris switched from the Democratic Party to the Republican Party.
Chuck Norris stated in interviews that he switched from the Democratic Party to the Republican Party.
Chuck Norris stated that the Democrats "got too far off the trail" and lost touch with American reality.
Chuck Norris believed the Democratic party moved too far left.
Chuck Norris believed "God and guns" are the foundation of America.
Chuck Norris campaigned for Mike Huckabee.
Chuck Norris campaigned for Ted Cruz.
Chuck Norris campaigned for Donald Trump.
Chuck Norris was a writer for WorldNetDaily.
Chuck Norris authored the book "Black Belt Patriotism".
Chuck Norris opposed the inclusion of gay leaders in the Boy Scouts of America.
